Hello! Thank you for your interest in contributing to GitGut! Before opening a pull request, please first file an issue *and coordinate with the maintainers on what you want to achieve*. If there already is an issue, *before* making changes coordinate with the maintainers in the issue first. This helps you avoid duplicated efforts and improves the review process and project direction. To keep the review volume manageable, MRs which do not follow this will be closed.
